d:
REMASTERED IN HD!
The official video for Beautiful Day by U2.
Filmed in August 2000 at Charles de Gaulle airport in Paris, the first video from the album All That You Can’t Leave Behind was directed by Jonas Åkerlund and premiered the following month.
U2 - 'Beautiful Day' Lyrics:
The heart is a bloom, shoots up through stony ground
But there's no room, no space to rent in this town
You're out of luck and the reason that you had to care,
The traffic is stuck and you're not moving anywhere.
